historical_findings: The community explicitly noticed that the Xbox Braille readout contained numbers plus an apostrophe and dash outside the password letters.
The maintained solving document says their meaning was unresolved and presents filler/obscuration as one possibility.
The July 2018 TLDR describes only the legible Braille characters as spelling NEWPLANETDISCOVERED roughly, consistent with treating non-letter cells as unresolved rather than decoded payload.
No recovered historical source in this audit identifies a second-channel interpretation for the numeric cells.
new_observation_status: The existence of unexplained numbers is old. The specific no-5 census and exact nine-state match to CE A-I appear to be new observations in the currently recovered corpus.
operating_consequence: Treat the residual cells as historically unresolved evidence. Do not label them proven filler, and do not promote them to a CE key without an independently specified correspondence.
